unresolved_gaps: No independently readable original source was located for the attributed March 2 Bloomberg Intelligence estimate.
No sufficiently complete, dated global inventory of operational AI critical IT load was found for August 2026.
The NVIDIA disclosure does not provide the definitions and non-overlapping totals needed to establish whether global operational AI IT capacity exceeded 10 GW.
